svg.title: HyperLogLog
svg.desc: Reader IDs for article 42 are added with PFADD. Each ID is hashed: 14 bits pick one of 16,384 buckets, and the bucket keeps the longest run of zeros it has seen. User 81 raises bucket 3 from 4 to 6, user 17 is too short to change its bucket, and user 81 again hashes to the same place and changes nothing. PFCOUNT combines the buckets into about 1,203,000 readers against an exact 1,198,412, in at most 12 KB.
svg.text: One bucket per visit, repeats change nothing, and it all fits in 12 KB.
